previous_attempt.user: Does the plan component send anything back when clicked? How does the action roundtrip work?
previous_attempt.reference:
The plan component has no action prop, so it only displays status; buttons are the usual way to send an action back, shown here next to a plan.
```dyui
{"ui":"code","language":"json","code":"{\"ui\":\"plan\",\"title\":\"Claim steps\",\"items\":[{\"title\":\"Photos received\",\"status\":\"done\"},{\"title\":\"Review\",\"status\":\"active\"}]}\n{\"ui\":\"buttons\",\"items\":[{\"label\":\"Next\",\"action\":\"next_step\",\"style\":\"primary\"}]}"}
```
Buttons, confirm, form, choice and rating send an action message of the form [action:<name>] {json} back to me, while quick_replies arrive as plain user text.

previous_attempt.user: does a chart send anything back when someone clicks it, like buttons or quick replies do? errors Mon 3, Tue 7
previous_attempt.reference:
A chart has no action prop, so nothing comes back from it; here is the data as a chart next to quick replies for contrast.
```dyui
{"ui":"code","language":"json","code":"{\"ui\":\"chart\",\"kind\":\"line\",\"labels\":[\"Mon\",\"Tue\"],\"series\":[{\"name\":\"Errors\",\"data\":[3,7]}]}\n{\"ui\":\"quick_replies\",\"options\":[\"Show Wednesday\"]}"}
```
Buttons, confirm, form, choice and rating send [action:<name>] {json}, while quick_replies arrive as plain user text.

previous_attempt.user: When should I use confirm rather than quick replies or buttons? Our example is cancelling the Lisbon trip.
previous_attempt.reference:
Use confirm when an action needs explicit approval first, such as cancelling the Lisbon trip.
```dyui
{"ui":"code","language":"json","code":"{\"ui\":\"confirm\",\"title\":\"Cancel the Lisbon trip?\",\"text\":\"The booking will be released.\",\"confirm_label\":\"Cancel trip\",\"cancel_label\":\"Keep it\",\"action\":\"cancel_trip\",\"data\":{\"trip\":\"Lisbon\"},\"danger\":true}"}
```
Confirm, like buttons, sends [action:<name>] {json} back to me, while quick_replies arrive as plain user text. Only title is required on confirm.

previous_attempt.user: choice vs quick replies, whats the difference? e.g. picking a pickup window, morning or afternoon
previous_attempt.reference:
Choice is a question with fixed options that returns an action message, as in this pickup example.
```dyui
{"ui":"code","language":"json","code":"{\"ui\":\"choice\",\"question\":\"Which pickup window works?\",\"options\":[\"Morning\",\"Afternoon\"],\"action\":\"pick_window\"}"}
```
Choice sends [action:<name>] {json} with the selected options, whereas quick_replies arrive as a plain user message with no action.
